title: Release the limited validators through dev, qa and prod and re-run probe-schemas
description: After the squash PR from tasks 1-3 merges, build the mcp-gateway image from main and deploy it in the order set by sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess.environmentsOrder (dev docker compose, then qa, then prod on EKS ap-south-1). The release needs 1 approval (releaseProcess.approvalsRequired) and must have this initiative's rollback plan attached. sdlc/policy.json defines no deploymentWindows and the mcp-gateway env files define no changeFreeze, so pick a low-traffic prod slot and confirm it with the CISO before deploying. In qa, run the existing agent query set against the client-data and order stores to confirm nothing legitimate is rejected before promoting to prod. Update applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server.json pinnedCommit to the merged commit, then re-run probe-schemas for mcp-gateway. Aim to finish before the finding's slaDueAt of 2026-09-28T13:14:50Z.
acceptanceCriteria: The prod mcp-gateway deployment runs an image built from the merged commit, and applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server.json pinnedCommit equals that commit

The qa agent query set completes with zero validation rejections of legitimate queries, and a deliberately oversized filter (over MAX_EJSON_BYTES) sent to the find tool in qa returns a validation error without reaching the driver

The re-run of probe-schemas for mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server writes a SARIF export with no SCH-API-02 fail result at src/tools/args.ts, and its observation for sebi-cscrf-2024:PR.IP.S2 on this repo is not not-satisfied

verificationMethod.description: Run `/probe-schemas example-co --app mcp-gateway` against the updated pinnedCommit. Expected result: the SARIF export has no SCH-API-02 fail result for src/tools/args.ts or src/tools/mongodb/mongodbTool.ts, so fingerprint 972eb67e82a0bd45304b76ee039ea11300642088dc044b5848de7c8df60a2840 is not produced. refresh-soc can then resolve fnd_01M2G2AGX1GZ9THG6HJ1VPP1EP under the two-run absence rule.

rootCause.description: The unlimited validators shipped in the running gateway image. Closing the gap needs the fixed code in prod and a fresh probe-schemas result, not just a merged PR.
